_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Stars, forks and language come live from the GitHub API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's own. 'repo' may be owner/repo for a repo that lives in an org, and 'name' overrides the card title and filename.

projects.name: ADAPT
projects.description: MRI brain scans sorted into stages of Alzheimer's by a VGG19 model, served as a FastAPI inference endpoint with Grad-CAM overlays so a clinician can see what the network looked at.
A diabetes risk classifier at 83% accuracy, built end to end from preprocessing to a deployed Flask service. Top 10 in India at the Intel AI Hackathon, IEEE INDICON, IIT Kharagpur.
Forecasting real electrical load. SARIMAX down to an RMSE of 1.35 after trend decomposition and feature work, with an LSTM tried against it for the longer temporal patterns.

projects.name: portfolio
projects.description: The site this profile links to. React 19 and TypeScript on Vite, Framer Motion for the transitions, and no router - the history API by hand, because two pages don't need a dependency.
